thought: Population-based optimizer using DE/current-to-best/1 mutation with success-history adaptation of F and CR (inspired by JADE). After each generation, a small local Gaussian perturbation around the best is performed. If no improvement for 2*dim generations, the population is reinitialized with 30% focused around the best and 70% uniformly random. Population size scales with sqrt(dim). Budget is strictly tracked; all points are clipped to bounds. Seed controls randomness.
